scenario: [LFAC.9.3]: a rule's `emit` supplies `ts: now()`. `ts` is read-only to authors, so the compiler refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_TS_READ_ONLY. The value supplied is exactly the one the engine would fill ([LFAC.9.2]), so a check that compared values instead of refusing the write would pass this rule.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key

schema Marker scope logical:
    k: Int key
    ts: Time

rule mark:
    Trig t
->
    emit Marker logical k: t.k ts: now()
